_comment: Settings of bpmn-tobe (plans/bpmn-tobe.md). The only place that decides the annotation kinds, their colours and the TO-BE layout. Adding a kind (e.g. riesgo, amarillo) = adding an entry to kinds. Colours are soft on purpose (user, 2026-09-28): a pale fill and a muted, dark enough stroke that also colours the text.

no-bands.description: Option A: AS-IS and TO-BE rendered apart with a layout that never opens room bands, so annotations cannot move the process.

derive-as-is.description: Option A': the TO-BE is rendered with the skill's default layout (room bands included) and the AS-IS is that same drawing without the marks, so both share their geometry by construction.
